# SlimTide®

> SlimTide® is a metabolic and digestive support dietary supplement combining prebiotic fiber and a three-strain probiotic blend — including *Akkermansia muciniphila* — to support gut microbiome balance, healthy weight management, appetite control, stable blood sugar, and sustained daily energy. Manufactured in a GMP-certified, FDA-registered facility in the USA. Available exclusively online with a 60-day money-back guarantee.

## Product

[SlimTide® Official Order Page](https://slimtide-us.vercel.app/)

SlimTide® contains Chicory Root Inulin (prebiotic fiber), Potato Resistant Starch (fermentable substrate for SCFA production), and a three-strain probiotic blend anchored by *Akkermansia muciniphila* — a next-generation strain linked in research to healthier metabolic markers and improved body composition. One vegetarian capsule daily. Refrigerate after opening. 30 capsules per bottle (30-day supply).
